name: Twin Haze
description: Seat a haze on each side of a foe so that the foe cannot tell which side the user will strike from.

name: Twin Hide
description: Hide an ally in a second fog beside the user's own so that watchers lose both.

name: Pair Stride
description: Stride from one fog bank to its twin in a single motion.

name: Mist Warrant
description: Serve a warrant of cold mist on one foe that holds the foe's limbs until the court has done.

name: Twin Slice
description: Cut from both fog banks together so that the foe is struck twice in one breath.

name: Paired Shroud
description: Draw a shroud round the user from each court so that the blow must pass both to land.

name: Twin Trial
description: Set two courts of fog on the ground that each foe who enters is tried in and held until released.

name: Mist Verdict
description: Pass the verdict of both courts on a foe and press the foe down under the combined weight of the fog.

name: Fogwalk Twin
description: Send both the user and one chosen ally into mist so that they pass through any barrier together.

name: Azure Haze
description: Turn the air a pale blue that the eye cannot tell from the sky behind the user.

name: Sky Dew
description: Read the dew that falls from the high haze and learn what moves far above and beyond.

name: Azure Slip
description: Slip into the blue haze and come out a few paces away.

name: Dull Blue
description: Dull the user's colour to the blue of distance so that blows fall wide.

name: Haze Lance
description: Harden a thread of blue haze into a lance and pierce one foe at long range.

name: Blue Drift
description: Drift on the blue haze across open ground faster than the eye can follow.

name: Soft Horizon
description: Soften the far line of sight until a foe cannot judge any distance at all.

name: Azure Pall
description: Spread a pall of blue haze that dulls and chills any foe who breathes it.

name: Sky Lock
description: Lock a foe's techniques behind a lid of grey sky so that none can be drawn.

name: Azure Vanish
description: Vanish into the blue haze between one glance and the next and reappear far from where the foe looked.

name: Hawk Brume
description: Hold a hawk's wide patient watch from inside the brume.

name: Stoop Fog
description: Stoop out of the fog onto a foe with a blow carrying the speed of a fall.

name: Brume Perch
description: Perch inside a close knot of brume that turns aside grasping hands.

name: Talon Mist
description: Form talons of mist on the fingers and drive them in under a foe's guard.

name: Circling Brume
description: Circle the brume about a foe until the foe turns and turns and loses the user.

name: Wing Brume
description: Spread wings of brume and glide a long way over the ground.

name: Brume Descent
description: Drop a heavy mass of brume on a wide area so that every foe in it is driven down.

name: Hawk Shroud
description: Spread a hawk's cloud of brume over a group of allies so that all are hidden and quickened.

name: Brume Swallow
description: Let a great blow sink into the brume as a stone sinks into a bog so that its force is lost.

name: Cupped Dew
description: Gather dew in a basin of the palms and drink its cool strength.

name: Silt Fog
description: Stir a fog thick with silt into a foe's face so that the foe loses sight and rhythm.

name: Fog Glide
description: Slip down the lip of the basin into the fog below and come out elsewhere.

name: Dew Cover
description: Draw a cover of fine dew over the body that slows and cools a blow.

name: Dew Wash
description: Pour the basin's clean dew on an ally to wash out poison and a clinging curse.

name: Fog Surge
description: Surge the river of fog down a street and sweep every foe off their feet.

name: Fog Hide
description: Hide the user and friends beneath the bank of running fog so that foes search the wrong shore.

name: Mist Torrent
description: Unleash a torrent of fog that batters every foe in its path and carries them off.

name: Fog Shut
description: Seal a basin of fog on the ground that closes over any foe who steps into it.

name: Mist Phase
description: Flow as a river of mist through walls and gates and doors and rise again beyond them.

name: Level Fog
description: Lay a level fog across the ground so that foes cannot judge where the next step lands.

name: Wide Haze
description: Throw a wide low haze that hides the user's feet and hands from the foe.

name: Gust Mist
description: Ride a gust through the mist and arrive at the foe's side.

name: Fog Brace
description: Brace against the blow with a thick plain of fog that takes it evenly.

name: Flat Pall
description: Press a flat pall down on a foe so that the foe moves as if wading.

name: Edge Mist
description: Read the farthest edge of the fog and feel anything that nears it.

name: Closing Haze
description: Set a broad haze on open ground that closes round any who cross it.

name: Fog Gale
description: Drive the fog before a hard wind so that it scours every foe in its path.

name: Fog Levelling
description: Level the whole field with a heavy fog so that every foe stands flat and slow within it.

name: Sworn Mist
description: Hold a mist sworn to the user's defence so that it thickens at every blow.

name: Oath Haze
description: Breathe an oath into a haze that confuses any who have broken one.

name: Pledge Dew
description: Lay pledge dew on an ally so that the ally holds firm and unseen through the fight.

name: Bound Wisp
description: Bind a wisp of mist about a foe's wrist so that it clings until released.

name: Oath Fog
description: Seal the fog with an oath so that a foe who tries to break it finds their own technique closed.

name: Truth Mist
description: Let the mist sour round a liar so that the user learns when a spoken word is false.

name: Oath Rinse
description: Wash the guilt and the grey taint of a hard choice out of an ally.

name: Vow Pall
description: Spread a pall that lets faithful allies pass and closes round any who would betray them.

name: Broken Faith
description: Press the full weight of the mist on a foe who has broken a sworn word.

name: Faith Reckoning
description: Call the sworn mist to strike an oath-breaker with a harm that no guard can turn.

name: Fog Bearing
description: Hold a true bearing on a point through fog so thick the eye sees only grey.

name: Grey Heading
description: Walk a straight heading in the grey and arrive exactly where the bearing led.

name: Murk Brace
description: Brace in the murk with the body angled to a bearing so that blows meet the thickest guard.

name: Bearing Haze
description: Spoil a foe's bearing with a haze that turns every landmark to grey.

name: Blind Fix
description: Fix the place of every ally in the fog and keep them all in the user's mind.

name: Heading Wisp
description: Send a wisp ahead on the heading and step to where it hangs.

name: Fog Course
description: Lay a course through the fog that guides allies safely and misleads every foe.

name: Lost Marker
description: Erase every marker a foe has fixed in the fog and leave the foe lost.

name: Fog Passage
description: Pass through any barrier along the held bearing as though it were more fog.

name: Open Mist
description: Leave the mist open in every direction and feel whatever stirs within it.

name: Free Fog
description: Let the fog carry the user a pace or two with no set direction.

name: Wind Haze
description: Whip a haze on the wind across a foe's sight.

name: Loose Brume
description: Hold the brume loose so that it gives with each blow and returns whole.

name: Mist Gust
description: Blow the mist out in a hard gust that shoves back every foe near the user.

name: Drift Free
description: Drift clear of a closing ring of foes on the freest edge of the mist.

name: Open Wash
description: Wash an ally in open mist to carry off a light poison and a lingering chill.

name: Edgeless Mist
description: Raise an edgeless mist over the ground so that no foe can find where it ends.

name: Mist Rend
description: Rend a foe's guard with a spear of mist that forms inside the guard itself.

name: Mist Unbound
description: Go wholly to mist so that blows pass through and barriers part and the user moves without a wall to stop it.
